en: Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start
zh: 变更 Claude Desktop 的 Code 标签页：当 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 指定一个由 Anthropic 运营、且服务于该 session 主机名的网关时，应用托管设置；该网关必须在启动时可访问
